item.title: Graphic Design Student Tracy Pepper Named Latest Winner of BMO BIPOC Creative Achievement Award
item.description: Toronto Film School student Tracy Pepper wins BMO BIPOC Award. The Métis author-illustrator is creating children's books while undergoing cancer treatment.

item.title: TFS Receives Shout-Out as MovieMaker Names Toronto #1 City for Filmmakers in 2026
item.description: Toronto ranks #1 on MovieMaker's 2026 Best Places to Live and Work as a Moviemaker in 2026 list. Learn why the city's film industry, tax incentives, and Toronto Film School earned Toronto top billing.

item.title: Black History Month Spotlight | Revisiting the Amazing Achievements of our TFS Community
item.description: Celebrate Black History Month with Toronto Film School as we spotlight inspiring Black students, alumni, and faculty—from award-winning filmmakers and actors to creative visionaries shaping Canada's entertainment industry.

item.title: Bearing Witness | TFS Grad Saja Kilani's Oscar-Nominated Film Gives Voice to Hind Rajab
item.description: TFS alumna Saja Kilani stars in Oscar-nominated The Voice of Hind Rajab, using her art to ensure a five-year-old girl's story will not be forgotten.

item.title: From Student to Teacher to Entrepreneur | Jamiel Moss's TFS Journey
item.description: From TFS valedictorian to instructor to entrepreneur, Jamiel Moss shares how the lessons he learned at Toronto Film School helped shape his career and thriving video production business.

item.title: Toronto Film School Students Bring '12 Angry Jurors' to Factory Theatre This March
item.description: Toronto Film School acting students tackle the timeless courtroom drama 12 Angry Jurors at Factory Theatre this March, with free performances on March 10, 11 and 12.

item.title: Toronto Film School's BIPOC Bursary Gets a Boost from BMO
item.description: BMO increases its annual support for Toronto Film School's BIPOC Creative Achievement Award to $8,000, boosting each quarterly bursary to $2,000 in 2026.

item.title: Celebrating Female Creatives | A TFS Spotlight in Honour of International Women's Day
item.description: This International Women’s Day 2026, we celebrate the extraordinary female creatives who make up the heart of the Toronto Film School community. item.title: Film Production Student Justin Abraham Varghese Named Latest Recipient of BMO BIPOC Creative Achievement Award
item.description: Film Production student Justin Abraham Varghese receives the BMO BIPOC Creative Achievement Award, now valued at $2,000.

item.title: Shamier Anderson Brings Hard-Won Industry Wisdom to Toronto Film School Students
item.description: Canadian actor Shamier Anderson shares career advice, lessons on rejection, and the realities of the industry with Toronto Film School acting students.
